cards.summary: Lined loose-leaf sheet in pencil, titled Patty.
cards.typed_words:
Patty
There once was this girl and this guy and me
Once just us two but we became three
She loved me for two years
Though she cried a thousand tears
We had our ups and downs and lefts and rights
Then I skipped town in the middle of the night
Yes I once loved her but I let her go
He fell in love and he told her so
A good man from her town
But he was caught on her rebound
He thought he was in good right from the start
The only problem was she closed her heart
As I soon learned it still belonged to me
Poor boy how was he supposed to see?

cards.name_on_card: I heard about an accident on the train
cards.summary: A handwritten poem on a single sheet of lined spiral-bound notebook paper.
cards.typed_words:
I heard about an accident on the train
That I normally take
This morning I overslept
Usually I'm never late
Somewhere along the line
It seems that someone made a mistake
And after the two trains collided
There was enough blood to fill a lake
It took nearly three days
For all the cars to seperate
These next words give me reason to hesitate
On what I will now say
First I must meditate
On the other train
was my son's favorite playmate
Along with his mom
Who was seven months pregnant
